result_text:
Template literals are now masked the same way as `"..."` and `'...'` literals when units are compared for duplication. I didn't write or run a test for the template-literal case itself. I ran the unit, JavaScript and duplication tests in `codeanalyzer`, and they passed.

The change is one added line in `extraCleanContent` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/units/CStyleHeuristicUnitsExtractor.java`. It replaces `` `...` `` with ` `` `, including any `${...}` inside.

Because the existing replacements are line-based, a template literal that spans several lines is not masked.
